## Chapter 001 — all approved (13 entries)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Value judgment** (*Ценностна преценка*): An assessment based partly on priorities or moral standards.<br>*Оценка, основана отчасти на приоритети или морални норми.* · defined in [001/four-statements-that-sound-similar-but-do-different-work](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/four-statements-that-sound-similar-but-do-different-work/)
- ✅ **Provenance** (*Произход*): A source’s origin and history of transmission or handling.<br>*Произходът на източника и историята на предаването или съхраняването му.* · defined in [001/the-right-evidence-for-the-right-question](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/the-right-evidence-for-the-right-question/)
- ✅ **Corroboration** (*Независимо потвърждение*): Confirmation through evidence not merely copied from one source.<br>*Потвърждение чрез доказателства, които не са просто копирани от един източник.* · defined in [001/the-danger-of-becoming-certain-that-nobody-knows-anything](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/the-danger-of-becoming-certain-that-nobody-knows-anything/) · related: calibrated-confidence
- ✅ **Lateral reading** (*Странично четене*): Checking an unfamiliar source using outside information and coverage.<br>*Проверка на непознат източник чрез външна информация и отразяване.* · defined in [001/following-a-claim-upstream](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/following-a-claim-upstream/) · related: sift
- ✅ **SIFT** (*SIFT*): Stop; Investigate source; Find better coverage; Trace to original context.<br>*Спри; проучи източника; намери по-добро отразяване; проследи до първоначалния контекст.* · defined in [001/following-a-claim-upstream](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/following-a-claim-upstream/) · related: lateral-reading
- ✅ **Counterfactual** (*Контрафактически сценарий*): What would have happened in a comparable world without the proposed cause.<br>*Какво би се случило в сравним свят без предполагаемата причина.* · defined in [001/from-a-pattern-to-a-cause](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/from-a-pattern-to-a-cause/) · related: reverse-causation
- ✅ **Reverse causation** (*Обратна причинност*): The supposed effect may influence the supposed cause.<br>*Предполагаемото следствие може да влияе на предполагаемата причина.* · defined in [001/from-a-pattern-to-a-cause](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/from-a-pattern-to-a-cause/) · related: counterfactual
- ✅ **Systematic review** (*Систематичен преглед*): Explicitly finds and appraises a body of research to address a question.<br>*Изрично намира и оценява съвкупност от изследвания, за да отговори на въпрос.* · defined in [001/what-science-can-offer-and-what-it-cannot-settle-alone](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/what-science-can-offer-and-what-it-cannot-settle-alone/) · related: peer-review
- ✅ **Peer review** (*Експертно рецензиране*): Expert scrutiny before publication, not a guarantee of truth.<br>*Експертна проверка преди публикуване, а не гаранция за истинност.* · defined in [001/what-science-can-offer-and-what-it-cannot-settle-alone](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/what-science-can-offer-and-what-it-cannot-settle-alone/) · related: systematic-review
- ✅ **Effect size** (*Размер на ефекта*): The magnitude of an observed difference or relationship.<br>*Големината на наблюдавана разлика или връзка.* · defined in [001/reading-a-research-headline-without-being-fooled](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/reading-a-research-headline-without-being-fooled/)
- ✅ **Confirmation bias** (*Склонност към потвърждение*): Selective attention or interpretation favoring existing beliefs.<br>*Избирателно внимание или тълкуване в полза на вече съществуващи убеждения.* · defined in [001/cognitive-bias-when-our-own-minds-become-part-of-the-problem](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/cognitive-bias-when-our-own-minds-become-part-of-the-problem/)
- ✅ **Prior probability** (*Априорна вероятност*): Background plausibility before assessing a new piece of evidence.<br>*Изходната правдоподобност преди оценката на ново доказателство.* · defined in [001/probability-is-the-language-of-reasonable-uncertainty](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/probability-is-the-language-of-reasonable-uncertainty/) · related: calibrated-confidence
- ✅ **Calibrated confidence** (*Калибрирана увереност*): Strength of belief matched to strength and limits of the evidence.<br>*Сила на убеждението, съобразена със силата и границите на доказателствата.* · defined in [001/the-danger-of-becoming-certain-that-nobody-knows-anything](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/001-how-to-know-what-is-true/the-danger-of-becoming-certain-that-nobody-knows-anything/) · related: corroboration

## Chapter 002 — all approved (19 entries)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Validity** (*Валидност*): Impossible for all premises to be true and conclusion false.<br>*Невъзможно е всички предпоставки да са верни, а заключението – невярно.* · defined in [002/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true/) · related: sound-argument, counterexample, affirming-the-consequent, modus-tollens
- ✅ **Sound argument** (*Коректен аргумент*): A valid deductive argument whose premises are true.<br>*Валиден дедуктивен аргумент, чиито предпоставки са верни.* · defined in [002/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true/) · related: deductive-validity, counterexample, affirming-the-consequent, modus-tollens
- ✅ **Counterexample** (*Контрапример*): A case with true premises but false conclusion; shows invalidity.<br>*Случай с верни предпоставки, но невярно заключение; показва, че изводът не е валиден.* · defined in [002/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true/) · related: deductive-validity, sound-argument, affirming-the-consequent, modus-tollens
- ✅ **Affirming the consequent** (*Утвърждаване на следствието*): Mistaking Q for proof of P in “if P, then Q”.<br>*Грешката да приемем Q за доказателство за P при „ако P, то Q“.* · defined in [002/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true/) · related: deductive-validity, sound-argument, counterexample, modus-tollens
- ✅ **Modus tollens** (*Modus tollens*): From “if P then Q” and “not Q,” infer “not P”.<br>*От „ако P, то Q“ и „не Q“ следва „не P“.* · defined in [002/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/valid-is-not-the-same-as-true/) · related: deductive-validity, sound-argument, counterexample, affirming-the-consequent
- ✅ **Sufficient condition** (*Достатъчно условие*): A guarantees B under the stated relationship.<br>*A гарантира B при посочената връзка.* · defined in [002/necessary-sufficient-and-merely-associated](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/necessary-sufficient-and-merely-associated/)
- ✅ **Necessary condition** (*Необходимо условие*): B cannot occur unless A is present.<br>*B не може да настъпи, ако A не е налице.* · defined in [002/necessary-sufficient-and-merely-associated](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/necessary-sufficient-and-merely-associated/)
- ✅ **Induction** (*Индукция*): Generalization or prediction supported by observed cases.<br>*Обобщение или прогноза, подкрепени от наблюдавани случаи.* · defined in [002/three-ways-to-reason-about-the-unknown](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/three-ways-to-reason-about-the-unknown/) · related: abduction
- ✅ **Abduction** (*Абдукция*): Reasoning to the best supported explanation of evidence.<br>*Разсъждение към най-добре подкрепеното обяснение на доказателствата.* · defined in [002/three-ways-to-reason-about-the-unknown](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/three-ways-to-reason-about-the-unknown/) · related: induction
- ✅ **Hidden premise** (*Скрита предпоставка*): An unstated assumption needed for an argument to work.<br>*Неизказано допускане, без което аргументът не работи.* · defined in [002/the-anatomy-of-a-reasoned-claim](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/the-anatomy-of-a-reasoned-claim/)
- ✅ **Causal claim** (*Причинно твърдение*): Says what produced an outcome, not merely what occurred.<br>*Казва какво е предизвикало даден резултат, а не само какво се е случило.* · defined in [002/facts-definitions-predictions-and-values](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/facts-definitions-predictions-and-values/)
- ✅ **Straw man** (*Сламен човек*): Attacking a distorted version of someone’s real position.<br>*Нападение срещу изкривена версия на действителната позиция на някого.* · defined in [002/straw-men-steel-men-and-the-temptation-to-win](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/straw-men-steel-men-and-the-temptation-to-win/) · related: steelman
- ✅ **Steelman** (*Стоманен човек*): Presenting an opponent’s strongest defensible argument fairly.<br>*Честно представяне на най-силния защитим аргумент на опонента.* · defined in [002/straw-men-steel-men-and-the-temptation-to-win](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/straw-men-steel-men-and-the-temptation-to-win/) · related: straw-man
- ✅ **False dilemma** (*Фалшива дилема*): Presenting an incomplete range as the only possible choices.<br>*Представяне на непълен набор от възможности като единствените възможни.* · defined in [002/false-choices-slippery-slopes-and-arguments-from-fear](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/false-choices-slippery-slopes-and-arguments-from-fear/)
- ✅ **Appeal to popularity** (*Позоваване на популярността*): Numbers of believers do not themselves prove a factual claim.<br>*Броят на вярващите сам по себе си не доказва едно фактическо твърдение.* · defined in [002/popularity-authority-tradition-and-novelty](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/popularity-authority-tradition-and-novelty/)
- ✅ **Cherry-picking** (*Избирателно подбиране*): Selecting favorable evidence while hiding relevant contrary evidence.<br>*Подбиране на удобните доказателства и скриване на съществените противоположни.* · defined in [002/bad-generalizations-and-selective-evidence](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/bad-generalizations-and-selective-evidence/) · related: counterexample, survivorship-bias
- ✅ **Survivorship bias** (*Изкривяване на оцелелите*): Ignoring failed or disappeared cases in a comparison.<br>*Пренебрегване на неуспелите или изчезналите случаи при сравнение.* · defined in [002/bad-generalizations-and-selective-evidence](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/bad-generalizations-and-selective-evidence/) · related: counterexample, cherry-picking
- ✅ **Circular reasoning** (*Кръгово разсъждение*): Reasons already assume the disputed conclusion.<br>*Доводите вече предполагат спорното заключение.* · defined in [002/circular-arguments-moving-goalposts-and-the-burden-of-proof](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/circular-arguments-moving-goalposts-and-the-burden-of-proof/)
- ✅ **Fallacy fallacy** (*Заблудата за заблудата*): Assuming a conclusion false because one defense of it is weak.<br>*Допускането, че едно заключение е невярно, защото една негова защита е слаба.* · defined in [002/the-fallacy-fallacy-and-why-disagreement-remains-difficult](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/002-logic-arguments-and-common-fallacies/the-fallacy-fallacy-and-why-disagreement-remains-difficult/)

## Chapter 003 — all approved (13 entries)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Independent events** (*Независими събития*): Knowing one outcome does not change the probability of the other.<br>*Знанието за единия изход не променя вероятността на другия.* · defined in [003/three-simple-rules-for-combining-chances](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/three-simple-rules-for-combining-chances/) · related: mutually-exclusive-events
- ✅ **Mutually exclusive events** (*Несъвместими събития*): Events that cannot occur together in the same trial.<br>*Събития, които не могат да настъпят заедно в един и същ опит.* · defined in [003/three-simple-rules-for-combining-chances](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/three-simple-rules-for-combining-chances/) · related: independent-events
- ✅ **Base rate** (*Базова честота*): Starting prevalence of an event in the relevant population.<br>*Изходната честота на дадено събитие в съответната съвкупност.* · defined in [003/the-fraud-alarm-counted-properly](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/the-fraud-alarm-counted-properly/)
- ✅ **False positive** (*Фалшиво положителен резултат*): An alert occurs even though the target event is absent.<br>*Сигнал се задейства, въпреки че търсеното събитие липсва.* · defined in [003/the-fraud-alarm-counted-properly](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/the-fraud-alarm-counted-properly/) · related: base-rate
- ✅ **Absolute risk reduction** (*Абсолютно намаление на риска*): Difference between event probabilities, in percentage points.<br>*Разликата между вероятностите на събитието, в процентни пунктове.* · defined in [003/the-size-of-a-risk-matters-as-much-as-its-direction](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/the-size-of-a-risk-matters-as-much-as-its-direction/)
- ✅ **Relative risk reduction** (*Относително намаление на риска*): Absolute risk reduction divided by original risk.<br>*Абсолютното намаление на риска, разделено на първоначалния риск.* · defined in [003/the-size-of-a-risk-matters-as-much-as-its-direction](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/the-size-of-a-risk-matters-as-much-as-its-direction/) · related: absolute-risk-reduction
- ✅ **Expected value** (*Очаквана стойност*): Sum of outcome amounts, each weighted by its probability.<br>*Сборът от възможните суми, всяка умножена по вероятността си.* · defined in [003/expected-value-the-average-you-may-never-personally-see](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/expected-value-the-average-you-may-never-personally-see/) · related: mutually-exclusive-events
- ✅ **Probability distribution** (*Вероятностно разпределение*): Possible outcomes and their respective probabilities.<br>*Възможните изходи и съответните им вероятности.* · defined in [003/variability-two-roads-with-the-same-average](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/variability-two-roads-with-the-same-average/) · related: expected-value
- ✅ **Gambler’s fallacy** (*Заблуда на комарджията*): Assuming independent random outcomes must compensate for a streak.<br>*Убеждението, че независимите случайни изходи трябва да „компенсират“ поредица.* · defined in [003/small-samples-streaks-and-the-human-search-for-patterns](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/small-samples-streaks-and-the-human-search-for-patterns/) · related: independent-events, regression-to-the-mean
- ✅ **Regression toward the mean** (*Регресия към средното*): Extreme observations are often followed by less extreme ones.<br>*След крайни наблюдения често следват по-малко крайни.* · defined in [003/small-samples-streaks-and-the-human-search-for-patterns](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/small-samples-streaks-and-the-human-search-for-patterns/) · related: independent-events, gamblers-fallacy
- ✅ **Forecast calibration** (*Калибриране на прогнозите*): How closely predicted frequencies match observed frequencies over cases.<br>*Доколко прогнозираните честоти съвпадат с наблюдаваните в много случаи.* · defined in [003/forecasts-should-be-judged-as-forecasts](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/forecasts-should-be-judged-as-forecasts/)
- ✅ **Sampling uncertainty** (*Извадкова неопределеност*): Variation in estimates arising from which sample was drawn.<br>*Колебание в оценките, което идва от това коя извадка е взета.* · defined in [003/where-confidence-comes-from-and-where-it-should-stop](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/where-confidence-comes-from-and-where-it-should-stop/) · related: independent-events
- ✅ **Selection bias** (*Изкривяване при подбора*): The observed group systematically differs from the target group.<br>*Наблюдаваната група систематично се различава от целевата.* · defined in [003/how-statistics-become-misleading-without-any-false](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/003-probability-risk-and-everyday-numbers/how-statistics-become-misleading-without-any-false/)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Periodization** (*Периодизация*): Dividing history into interpretive periods.<br>*Разделяне на историята на периоди, които са тълкувания.* · defined in [004/periods-are-questions-not-fences](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/periods-are-questions-not-fences/) · related: presentism, archival-survivorship-bias
- ✅ **Presentism** (*Презентизъм*): Projecting present-day categories onto the past without context.<br>*Пренасяне на днешни категории върху миналото без отчитане на контекста.* · defined in [004/periods-are-questions-not-fences](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/periods-are-questions-not-fences/) · related: periodization, archival-survivorship-bias
- ✅ **Archival survivorship bias** (*Архивно изкривяване на оцелелите*): Surviving records reflect preservation and selection, not all past life.<br>*Оцелелите записи отразяват съхраняването и подбора, а не целия минал живот.* · defined in [004/the-past-leaves-traces-not-finished-stories](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/the-past-leaves-traces-not-finished-stories/) · related: dendrochronology
- ✅ **Stratigraphy** (*Стратиграфия*): Studying the sequence and relationships of archaeological layers.<br>*Изучаване на последователността и връзките между археологическите пластове.* · defined in [004/archaeology-reading-what-people-left-behind](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/archaeology-reading-what-people-left-behind/)
- ✅ **Dendrochronology** (*Дендрохронология*): Dating by patterns of tree-growth rings.<br>*Датиране по рисунъка на годишните пръстени на дърветата.* · defined in [004/how-historians-and-archaeologists-date-things](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/how-historians-and-archaeologists-date-things/) · related: archival-survivorship-bias, radiocarbon-dating, old-wood-effect
- ✅ **Radiocarbon dating** (*Радиовъглеродно датиране*): Dating by the carbon-14 remaining in material from once-living organisms (with calibration and limits).<br>*Датиране по останалия въглерод-14 в материал от някога живи организми (с калибриране и граници).* · defined in [004/how-historians-and-archaeologists-date-things](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/how-historians-and-archaeologists-date-things/) · related: archival-survivorship-bias, dendrochronology, old-wood-effect
- ✅ **Old-wood effect** (*Ефект на старата дървесина*): Wood growth can substantially predate its later use or burning.<br>*Дървесината може да е израснала много преди по-късното ѝ използване или изгаряне.* · defined in [004/how-historians-and-archaeologists-date-things](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/004-historical-time-and-the-problem-of-sources/how-historians-and-archaeologists-date-things/) · related: archival-survivorship-bias, dendrochronology, radiocarbon-dating

### Concepts

- ✅ **Geographical scale** (*Географски мащаб*): The spatial extent and level of detail used to study a pattern.<br>*Пространственият обхват и степента на подробност, с които изучаваме една закономерност.* · defined in [005/what-exactly-does-geography-study](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/what-exactly-does-geography-study/)
- ✅ **Mercator projection** (*Проекция на Меркатор*): A projection that preserves local angles, so constant-bearing rhumb lines appear straight.<br>*Проекция, която запазва местните ъгли, така че линиите с постоянен курс (локсодромите) изглеждат прави.* · defined in [005/the-impossible-promise-of-a-perfect-map](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/the-impossible-promise-of-a-perfect-map/) · related: geographical-scale, equal-area-projection, great-circle-route, latitude
- ✅ **Equal-area projection** (*Равноплощна проекция*): A projection that preserves proportional surface area, at the expense of some shapes.<br>*Проекция, която запазва пропорциите на площите за сметка на някои форми.* · defined in [005/the-impossible-promise-of-a-perfect-map](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/the-impossible-promise-of-a-perfect-map/) · related: geographical-scale, mercator-projection, great-circle-route, latitude
- ✅ **Great-circle route** (*Маршрут по голям кръг*): The shortest surface path between points on an ideal sphere.<br>*Най-краткият път по повърхността между две точки на идеална сфера.* · defined in [005/the-impossible-promise-of-a-perfect-map](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/the-impossible-promise-of-a-perfect-map/) · related: geographical-scale, mercator-projection, equal-area-projection, latitude
- ✅ **Latitude** (*Географска ширина*): Angular position north or south of the Equator.<br>*Ъгловото положение на север или на юг от екватора.* · defined in [005/finding-any-place-coordinates-orientation-and-the-grid](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/finding-any-place-coordinates-orientation-and-the-grid/) · related: great-circle-route
- ✅ **Convergent boundary** (*Конвергентна граница*): A boundary where plates move toward one another.<br>*Граница, при която плочите се движат една към друга.* · defined in [005/earths-moving-shell-plates-mountains-and-earthquakes](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/earths-moving-shell-plates-mountains-and-earthquakes/) · related: drainage-divide
- ✅ **Drainage divide** (*Вододел*): High ground separating neighbouring river catchments.<br>*Възвишение, което разделя съседни речни водосборни басейни.* · defined in [005/water-gives-the-landscape-its-circulation](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/water-gives-the-landscape-its-circulation/)
- ✅ **Rain shadow** (*Дъждовна сянка*): Drier leeward conditions associated with moist air crossing relief.<br>*По-сухи условия от подветрената страна, когато влажен въздух преминава над релеф.* · defined in [005/why-climate-varies-sunlight-air-altitude-and-water](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/why-climate-varies-sunlight-air-altitude-and-water/) · related: geographical-scale, latitude, monsoon
- ✅ **Monsoon** (*Мусон*): Seasonal large-scale change in atmospheric circulation and rainfall.<br>*Сезонна мащабна промяна в атмосферната циркулация и валежите.* · defined in [005/why-climate-varies-sunlight-air-altitude-and-water](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/why-climate-varies-sunlight-air-altitude-and-water/) · related: geographical-scale, latitude, rain-shadow
- ✅ **Coastal upwelling** (*Крайбрежен ъпуелинг*): Cold, nutrient-rich deeper water replaces displaced surface water.<br>*Студена, богата на хранителни вещества дълбока вода заменя изместената повърхностна вода.* · defined in [005/oceans-the-great-highways-and-climate-engines](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/oceans-the-great-highways-and-climate-engines/) · related: maritime-chokepoint, population-density
- ✅ **Maritime chokepoint** (*Морско тясно място*): A narrow route on which major shipping connections concentrate.<br>*Тесен морски път, по който се съсредоточават големи корабни връзки.* · defined in [005/oceans-the-great-highways-and-climate-engines](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/oceans-the-great-highways-and-climate-engines/) · related: coastal-upwelling, population-density
- ✅ **Population density** (*Гъстота на населението*): Number of people divided by area, usually per km².<br>*Броят на хората, разделен на площта, обикновено на км².* · defined in [005/people-cities-and-the-uneven-map-of-opportunity](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/people-cities-and-the-uneven-map-of-opportunity/) · related: drainage-divide, agglomeration-economy
- ✅ **Agglomeration economy** (*Агломерационна изгода*): Benefit from firms and workers locating near one another.<br>*Изгода от това фирми и работници да се разполагат близо едни до други.* · defined in [005/people-cities-and-the-uneven-map-of-opportunity](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/people-cities-and-the-uneven-map-of-opportunity/) · related: drainage-divide, population-density
- ✅ **Choropleth map** (*Картограма*): A map shading geographic units by a specified data value.<br>*Карта, която оцветява географски единици според дадена стойност на данните.* · defined in [005/reading-thematic-maps-without-being-fooled](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/reading-thematic-maps-without-being-fooled/) · related: population-density, ecological-fallacy
- ✅ **Ecological fallacy** (*Екологична заблуда*): Mistaking a group-level relationship for an individual-level one.<br>*Приемане на връзка на ниво група за връзка на ниво отделен човек.* · defined in [005/reading-thematic-maps-without-being-fooled](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/005-geography-maps-and-scale/reading-thematic-maps-without-being-fooled/) · related: population-density, choropleth-map

## Chapter 006 — all approved (14 entries)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Unit of observation** (*Единица на наблюдение*): The person, event, place or object described by one record.<br>*Лицето, събитието, мястото или обектът, описани от един запис.* · defined in [006/a-number-is-an-answer-to-a-question](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/a-number-is-an-answer-to-a-question/) · related: weighted-mean
- ✅ **Sampling frame** (*Извадкова рамка*): The list or mechanism through which eligible units can be sampled.<br>*Списъкът или механизмът, чрез който допустимите единици могат да попаднат в извадката.* · defined in [006/sampling-who-gets-counted-and-who-never-had-a-chance](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/sampling-who-gets-counted-and-who-never-had-a-chance/) · related: nonresponse-bias
- ✅ **Nonresponse bias** (*Изкривяване от неотговорили*): Responders and nonresponders differ on a relevant characteristic.<br>*Отговорилите и неотговорилите се различават по съществена характеристика.* · defined in [006/sampling-who-gets-counted-and-who-never-had-a-chance](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/sampling-who-gets-counted-and-who-never-had-a-chance/) · related: sampling-frame
- ✅ **Weighted mean** (*Претеглена средна стойност*): Groups contribute in proportion to their relevant sizes or weights.<br>*Групите допринасят пропорционално на съответните си размери или тегла.* · defined in [006/mean-median-mode-and-the-people-behind-the-average](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/mean-median-mode-and-the-people-behind-the-average/)
- ✅ **Standard deviation** (*Стандартно отклонение*): Typical dispersion of numerical observations around their mean.<br>*Типичното разсейване на числовите наблюдения около средната им стойност.* · defined in [006/spread-outliers-and-why-the-middle-is-never-the-whole-story](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/spread-outliers-and-why-the-middle-is-never-the-whole-story/) · related: outlier
- ✅ **Outlier** (*Отскачаща стойност*): An unusually distant value that may be real, erroneous or informative.<br>*Необичайно отдалечена стойност, която може да е реална, погрешна или показателна.* · defined in [006/spread-outliers-and-why-the-middle-is-never-the-whole-story](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/spread-outliers-and-why-the-middle-is-never-the-whole-story/) · related: standard-deviation
- ✅ **Logarithmic scale** (*Логаритмична скала*): Equal graph distances correspond to equal ratios, not equal differences.<br>*Равните разстояния на графиката съответстват на равни съотношения, а не на равни разлики.* · defined in [006/reading-graphs-as-arguments](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/reading-graphs-as-arguments/)
- ✅ **Moving average** (*Пълзяща средна*): Averages adjacent time periods to smooth short-term fluctuation.<br>*Осреднява съседни периоди, за да изглади краткосрочните колебания.* · defined in [006/time-series-where-the-chosen-starting-point-becomes](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/time-series-where-the-chosen-starting-point-becomes/)
- ✅ **Percentage points** (*Процентни пунктове*): Absolute difference between percentages, not relative percent growth.<br>*Абсолютната разлика между проценти, а не относителният ръст в проценти.* · defined in [006/percentages-percentage-points-and-changing-baselines](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/percentages-percentage-points-and-changing-baselines/)
- ✅ **Confounder** (*Смущаващ фактор*): A factor associated with both variables that complicates inference.<br>*Фактор, свързан и с двете променливи, който усложнява извода.* · defined in [006/correlation-a-relationship-not-a-mechanism](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/correlation-a-relationship-not-a-mechanism/) · related: outlier
- ✅ **Simpson's paradox** (*Парадокс на Симпсън*): An overall association can reverse when different groups are combined.<br>*Общата връзка може да се обърне, когато различни групи се обединят.* · defined in [006/simpsons-paradox-when-every-subgroup-tells-the-opposite](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/simpsons-paradox-when-every-subgroup-tells-the-opposite/)
- ✅ **Random assignment** (*Случайно разпределение*): Reduces systematic preexisting differences between comparison groups.<br>*Намалява систематичните предварителни разлики между сравняваните групи.* · defined in [006/experiments-comparison-groups-and-plausible-alternatives](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/experiments-comparison-groups-and-plausible-alternatives/) · related: percentage-points
- ✅ **Confidence interval** (*Доверителен интервал*): An interval method: over repetitions, roughly 95% of the intervals it constructs cover the parameter.<br>*Метод за интервали: при много повторения около 95% от построените интервали обхващат параметъра.* · defined in [006/confidence-intervals-being-precise-about-imprecision](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/confidence-intervals-being-precise-about-imprecision/) · related: nonresponse-bias, percentage-points
- ✅ **Data provenance** (*Произход на данните*): The documented path from original measurement to published figure.<br>*Документираният път от първоначалното измерване до публикуваната цифра.* · defined in [006/missing-data-revised-data-and-the-temptation-to-clean-away](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/006-reading-data-charts-and-statistics/missing-data-revised-data-and-the-temptation-to-clean-away/)

## Chapter 007 — all approved (21 entries)

### Concepts

- ✅ **System** (*Система*): Elements linked by interactions that generate behavior over time.<br>*Елементи, свързани чрез взаимодействия, които пораждат поведение във времето.* · defined in [007/what-is-a-system-and-what-is-not](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/what-is-a-system-and-what-is-not/) · related: system-boundary, flow
- ✅ **System boundary** (*Граница на системата*): The chosen scope of actors and processes in an analysis.<br>*Избраният обхват на участниците и процесите в един анализ.* · defined in [007/what-is-a-system-and-what-is-not](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/what-is-a-system-and-what-is-not/) · related: system, flow
- ✅ **Stock** (*Запас*): Quantity accumulated at a particular time.<br>*Количество, натрупано към даден момент.* · defined in [007/from-event-to-pattern-to-structure](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/from-event-to-pattern-to-structure/) · related: system, flow
- ✅ **Flow** (*Поток*): Rate that adds to or removes from a stock.<br>*Темп, който добавя към запаса или отнема от него.* · defined in [007/what-is-a-system-and-what-is-not](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/what-is-a-system-and-what-is-not/) · related: system, system-boundary
- ✅ **Buffer** (*Буфер*): Reserve that absorbs shocks, often at a cost.<br>*Резерв, който поема сътресения, често срещу някаква цена.* · defined in [007/where-to-intervene-symptoms-rules-information-and-goals](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/where-to-intervene-symptoms-rules-information-and-goals/) · related: system, flow, feedback-delay, bottleneck
- ✅ **Reinforcing feedback** (*Подсилваща обратна връзка*): Loop amplifying growth or decline.<br>*Кръг, който усилва растежа или спада.* · defined in [007/reinforcing-feedback-when-change-feeds-more-change](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/reinforcing-feedback-when-change-feeds-more-change/) · related: system, balancing-feedback
- ✅ **Balancing feedback** (*Балансираща обратна връзка*): Loop counteracting deviation or pursuing a target.<br>*Кръг, който противодейства на отклонението или се стреми към цел.* · defined in [007/balancing-feedback-how-a-system-pushes-back](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/balancing-feedback-how-a-system-pushes-back/) · related: system, stock, reinforcing-feedback, feedback-delay
- ✅ **Feedback delay** (*Забавяне на обратната връзка*): Time between a change, its signal and a response.<br>*Времето между една промяна, сигнала за нея и реакцията.* · defined in [007/balancing-feedback-how-a-system-pushes-back](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/balancing-feedback-how-a-system-pushes-back/) · related: system, stock, reinforcing-feedback, balancing-feedback
- ✅ **Nonlinearity** (*Нелинейност*): Output does not scale proportionally with input.<br>*Резултатът не се променя пропорционално на входа.* · defined in [007/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points/) · related: system, flow, feedback-delay, threshold
- ✅ **Threshold** (*Праг*): A region where behavior changes qualitatively.<br>*Област, в която поведението се променя качествено.* · defined in [007/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points/) · related: system, flow, feedback-delay, nonlinearity
- ✅ **Hysteresis** (*Хистерезис*): Reversing a pressure does not immediately restore the old state.<br>*Премахването на натиска не възстановява веднага предишното състояние.* · defined in [007/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points/) · related: system, flow, feedback-delay, nonlinearity
- ✅ **Path dependence** (*Зависимост от пътя*): Past adoption and constraints influence present outcomes.<br>*Минали избори и ограничения влияят на сегашните резултати.* · defined in [007/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/nonlinearity-thresholds-and-tipping-points/) · related: system, flow, feedback-delay, nonlinearity
- ✅ **Bottleneck** (*Тясно място*): The limiting stage or connection constraining throughput.<br>*Етапът или връзката, които ограничават пропускателната способност.* · defined in [007/networks-bottlenecks-and-the-weakest-link](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/networks-bottlenecks-and-the-weakest-link/) · related: network-redundancy
- ✅ **Network redundancy** (*Резервираност на мрежата*): Alternative connections that can maintain service after failure.<br>*Алтернативни връзки, които запазват работата след отпадане на някоя от тях.* · defined in [007/networks-bottlenecks-and-the-weakest-link](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/networks-bottlenecks-and-the-weakest-link/) · related: bottleneck
- ✅ **Common-pool resource** (*Общ ресурс*): Resource where exclusion is difficult and use subtracts from others.<br>*Ресурс, при който изключването е трудно, а използването му намалява наличното за другите.* · defined in [007/shared-resources-why-reasonable-choices-can-produce](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/shared-resources-why-reasonable-choices-can-produce/) · related: system, stock
- ✅ **Externality** (*Външен ефект*): Cost or benefit imposed on others outside the decision price.<br>*Разход или полза за други, която не влиза в цената на решението.* · defined in [007/economic-cycles-stocks-expectations-and-delayed-adjustment](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/economic-cycles-stocks-expectations-and-delayed-adjustment/) · related: system, stock, flow, feedback-delay
- ✅ **Security dilemma** (*Дилема на сигурността*): Defensive measures can appear threatening and invite mutual escalation.<br>*Отбранителните мерки могат да изглеждат заплашителни и да водят до взаимна ескалация.* · defined in [007/politics-and-the-security-dilemma](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/politics-and-the-security-dilemma/) · related: system
- ✅ **Unintended consequence** (*Непреднамерено последствие*): Behavioral response or side effect beyond the planned impact.<br>*Поведенческа реакция или страничен ефект извън планираното въздействие.* · defined in [007/unintended-consequences-and-the-limits-of-incentives](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/unintended-consequences-and-the-limits-of-incentives/) · related: system, goodharts-law
- ✅ **Goodhart's law** (*Законът на Гудхарт*): Targeting one proxy can distort incentives and weaken its meaning.<br>*Преследването на един показател като цел може да изкриви стимулите и да обезсмисли показателя.* · defined in [007/unintended-consequences-and-the-limits-of-incentives](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/unintended-consequences-and-the-limits-of-incentives/) · related: system, unintended-consequence
- ✅ **Leverage point** (*Точка на въздействие*): Place where intervention may meaningfully change system behavior.<br>*Място, където намесата може съществено да промени поведението на системата.* · defined in [007/where-to-intervene-symptoms-rules-information-and-goals](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/where-to-intervene-symptoms-rules-information-and-goals/) · related: system, flow, buffer, feedback-delay
- ✅ **Sensitivity analysis** (*Анализ на чувствителността*): Test how a conclusion changes with key assumptions.<br>*Проверка как се променя заключението при промяна на ключовите допускания.* · defined in [007/mapping-a-system-without-inventing-certainty](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/007-systems-thinking-and-feedback-loops/mapping-a-system-without-inventing-certainty/) · related: stock, flow, feedback-delay

## Chapter 008 — all approved (8 entries)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Retrieval practice** (*Упражнение по извличане*): Reconstructing knowledge from memory and checking it.<br>*Възстановяване на знанието по памет и проверката му.* · defined in [008/four-stages-attention-encoding-retrieval-and-use](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/four-stages-attention-encoding-retrieval-and-use/) · related: self-explanation, transfer
- ✅ **Spaced practice** (*Разпределено упражнение*): Revisiting material across time rather than one cram session.<br>*Връщане към материала през интервали, вместо всичко наведнъж.* · defined in [008/spacing-forgetting-a-little-can-help-you-learn-more](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/spacing-forgetting-a-little-can-help-you-learn-more/) · related: retrieval-practice, self-explanation
- ✅ **Interleaving** (*Редуване*): Mixing related kinds of practice to improve discrimination.<br>*Смесване на сродни видове упражнения, за да се научим да ги различаваме.* · defined in [008/interleaving-mix-topics-for-a-reason](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/interleaving-mix-topics-for-a-reason/) · related: retrieval-practice
- ✅ **Self-explanation** (*Самообяснение*): Explaining steps or relationships in your own words.<br>*Обясняване на стъпките или връзките със собствени думи.* · defined in [008/understanding-needs-connection-not-just-repetition](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/understanding-needs-connection-not-just-repetition/) · related: fluency-illusion
- ✅ **Mental model** (*Мисловен модел*): Organized framework describing how ideas and causes connect.<br>*Подредена представа за това как се свързват идеите и причините.* · defined in [008/the-difference-between-knowing-a-fact-and-having-a-model](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/the-difference-between-knowing-a-fact-and-having-a-model/) · related: transfer
- ✅ **Transfer** (*Пренос*): Using knowledge in a new context or task.<br>*Използване на знанието в нов контекст или задача.* · defined in [008/four-stages-attention-encoding-retrieval-and-use](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/four-stages-attention-encoding-retrieval-and-use/) · related: retrieval-practice, self-explanation
- ✅ **Error log** (*Дневник на грешките*): Record of a mistake, its cause, correction, and revisit date.<br>*Запис на грешка, причината ѝ, поправката и дата за ново преглеждане.* · defined in [008/feedback-turn-errors-into-information](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/feedback-turn-errors-into-information/) · related: self-explanation
- ✅ **Illusion of fluency** (*Илюзия за владеене*): Mistaking easy rereading for durable mastery.<br>*Грешката да приемем лекото препрочитане за трайно владеене.* · defined in [008/understanding-needs-connection-not-just-repetition](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/008-how-to-learn-and-remember/understanding-needs-connection-not-just-repetition/) · related: self-explanation

### Concepts

- ✅ **Hominin** (*Хоминин*): Members of the human lineage after its split from the chimpanzee lineage.<br>*Представители на човешката линия след отделянето ѝ от линията на шимпанзетата.* · defined in [009/what-evolution-actually-means](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/what-evolution-actually-means/) · related: cumulative-culture
- ✅ **Bipedalism** (*Двукрако ходене*): Habitually moving on two legs.<br>*Обичайно придвижване на два крака.* · defined in [009/what-we-can-say-with-confidence-and-what-remains-open](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/what-we-can-say-with-confidence-and-what-remains-open/) · related: hominin, introgression, sahul
- ✅ **Introgression** (*Интрогресия*): Genetic ancestry transferred between diverged populations via mixing.<br>*Генетично наследство, пренесено между разделили се популации чрез смесване.* · defined in [009/neanderthals-denisovans-and-our-complicated-relatives](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/neanderthals-denisovans-and-our-complicated-relatives/) · related: denisovans
- ✅ **Denisovans** (*Денисовци*): Extinct human relatives recognized first by ancient DNA.<br>*Изчезнали човешки родственици, разпознати първо по древна ДНК.* · defined in [009/neanderthals-denisovans-and-our-complicated-relatives](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/neanderthals-denisovans-and-our-complicated-relatives/) · related: introgression
- ✅ **Sahul** (*Сахул*): Pleistocene landmass including Australia and New Guinea.<br>*Плейстоценска суша, включваща Австралия и Нова Гвинея.* · defined in [009/crossing-water-the-settlement-of-sahul](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/crossing-water-the-settlement-of-sahul/)
- ✅ **Beringia** (*Берингия*): Ancient land region connecting northeast Asia and northwest North America.<br>*Древна суша, която е свързвала Североизточна Азия и северозападната част на Северна Америка.* · defined in [009/toward-the-americas-ice-land-coast-and-unanswered-questions](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/toward-the-americas-ice-land-coast-and-unanswered-questions/)
- ✅ **Minimum age** (*Минимална възраст*): An object is at least as old as a younger layer covering it.<br>*Обектът е поне толкова стар, колкото по-младия пласт, който го покрива.* · defined in [009/language-images-stories-and-the-world-inside-the-mind](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/language-images-stories-and-the-world-inside-the-mind/) · related: cumulative-culture
- ✅ **Cumulative culture** (*Кумулативна култура*): Knowledge and techniques learned, modified, and transmitted over generations.<br>*Знания и умения, научавани, променяни и предавани през поколенията.* · defined in [009/language-images-stories-and-the-world-inside-the-mind](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/009-human-evolution-and-the-first-migrations/language-images-stories-and-the-world-inside-the-mind/) · related: minimum-age

### Concepts

- ✅ **Sedentism** (*Уседналост*): Living in one place for extended periods, not necessarily farming.<br>*Живот на едно място за дълги периоди – не непременно със земеделие.* · defined in [010/five-myths-to-retire](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/five-myths-to-retire/)
- ✅ **Niche construction** (*Изграждане на ниша*): Organisms—including people—alter environments that shape future selection.<br>*Организмите – включително хората – променят средата, която оформя бъдещия подбор.* · defined in [010/why-did-people-begin-farming-five-explanations-that-interact](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/why-did-people-begin-farming-five-explanations-that-interact/) · related: tell
- ✅ **Rachis** (*Рахис*): The main axis of a cereal head; its breakage offers domestication clues.<br>*Основната ос на житния клас; начинът, по който се чупи, дава улики за опитомяването.* · defined in [010/cultivation-is-not-the-same-as-domestication](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/cultivation-is-not-the-same-as-domestication/)
- ✅ **Nonshattering grain** (*Неронливо зърно*): Grain that retains seed-bearing structures longer instead of freely dispersing.<br>*Зърно, което по-дълго задържа семената, вместо да ги разпилява свободно.* · defined in [010/cultivation-is-not-the-same-as-domestication](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/cultivation-is-not-the-same-as-domestication/) · related: rachis
- ✅ **Tell** (*Тел*): Mound formed from repeated occupation and rebuilding at one settlement.<br>*Могила, образувана от многократно обитаване и презастрояване на едно селище.* · defined in [010/the-village-becomes-a-social-institution](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/the-village-becomes-a-social-institution/)
- ✅ **Granary** (*Хамбар*): Structure or system for collecting and preserving stored food.<br>*Постройка или система за събиране и запазване на складирана храна.* · defined in [010/the-granary-storing-tomorrows-food](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/the-granary-storing-tomorrows-food/) · related: surplus
- ✅ **Surplus** (*Излишък*): Output available beyond immediate uses after relevant costs and needs.<br>*Продукция отвъд непосредствените нужди, след като се покрият съответните разходи.* · defined in [010/from-food-production-to-crafts-exchange-and-authority](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/from-food-production-to-crafts-exchange-and-authority/)
- ✅ **Demic diffusion** (*Демична дифузия*): Spread of farming alongside migration of populations.<br>*Разпространение на земеделието заедно с преселването на хора.* · defined in [010/the-animal-partnership-herding-changes-the-clock](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/010-the-agricultural-revolution/the-animal-partnership-herding-changes-the-clock/)

### Concepts

- ✅ **Alluvial plain** (*Алувиална равнина*): Lowland formed by river-deposited sediment.<br>*Низина, образувана от наноси, отложени от реки.* · defined in [011/a-landscape-that-demanded-ingenuity](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/a-landscape-that-demanded-ingenuity/)
- ✅ **City-state** (*Град-държава*): A principal city and surrounding territory under a shared political authority.<br>*Главен град и околната му територия под обща политическа власт.* · defined in [011/what-is-a-city-and-what-is-a-state](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/what-is-a-city-and-what-is-a-state/) · related: institution
- ✅ **Institution** (*Институция*): An enduring rule, office or organization beyond any one individual.<br>*Трайно правило, длъжност или организация, по-голяма от всеки отделен човек.* · defined in [011/uruk-when-settlement-became-something-larger](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/uruk-when-settlement-became-something-larger/)
- ✅ **Cylinder seal** (*Цилиндричен печат*): Carved cylinder rolled on clay to impress an identifying design.<br>*Издълбан цилиндър, който се търкаля върху глина и оставя отличителен отпечатък.* · defined in [011/seals-tokens-and-the-problem-of-trust](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/seals-tokens-and-the-problem-of-trust/) · related: institution
- ✅ **Proto-cuneiform** (*Протоклинопис*): Early Mesopotamian signs used especially for quantities and accounting.<br>*Ранни месопотамски знаци, използвани най-вече за количества и сметки.* · defined in [011/the-invention-of-writing-was-not-a-single-flash-of-genius](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/the-invention-of-writing-was-not-a-single-flash-of-genius/) · related: cuneiform
- ✅ **Cuneiform** (*Клинопис*): Wedge-shaped script able to represent words and speech sounds.<br>*Клиновидно писмо, способно да предава думи и звуци на речта.* · defined in [011/the-invention-of-writing-was-not-a-single-flash-of-genius](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/the-invention-of-writing-was-not-a-single-flash-of-genius/) · related: proto-cuneiform
- ✅ **Legitimacy** (*Легитимност*): Reasons and symbols used to justify and sustain rule.<br>*Доводи и символи, с които властта се оправдава и поддържа.* · defined in [011/kingship-office-force-and-sacred-authority](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/kingship-office-force-and-sacred-authority/) · related: institution
- ✅ **Ziggurat** (*Зикурат*): Monumental stepped temple platform or tower of Mesopotamia.<br>*Монументална стъпаловидна храмова платформа или кула в Месопотамия.* · defined in [011/ur-iii-a-state-that-counted-almost-everything](https://knowledgekingdom.github.io/011-mesopotamia-and-the-first-states/ur-iii-a-state-that-counted-almost-everything/)
